text:
simon: From the postmortem: we've been seeing a recurring cache-eviction pattern causing brief latency spikes and downstream request errors. We need concrete runbook/playbook updates: clear triage steps, an easy-to-run quick-check script, escalation thresholds, and a fallback routing snippet. Assigning owners & timelines here.

maya: I can own the triage steps + quick-check scripts. Will draft a minimal shell script and put a PR up. Target: Thu EOD.

priya: I'll take the escalation matrix and paging rules; will draft language for when to page infra lead vs oncall. Aiming to have a doc by tomorrow.

alex: I'll add recommended commands and a few copy-paste snippets for oncall. Example quick log command: ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/router -c router --since=10m | grep -i evict``` Also adding dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/eviction-metrics (will include exact chart ids in PR).

oncall-bot: Incident-bot: runbook-change-request created (RB-432) — reviewers: simon, maya, priya.

simon: Action items recap (please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm):
- Maya -> triage checklist + scripts (PR by Thu EOD)
- Priya -> escalation matrix + paging rules (PR by Wed)
- Alex -> triage commands + dashboard links + fallback routing snippet (PR by Fri)
- Simon -> review + merge + coordinate a follow-up runbook drill (by next Mon)
Also add a concrete threshold: if cache_eviction_rate > 0.1% sustained for 5 minutes -> auto-escalate to infra oncall and trigger fallback routing.

maya: Draft triage checklist I'm adding to the runbook: 
1) Quick health checks:
   a) Check recent pod logs: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --since=10m | grep -i evict```
   b) Check cache hit ratio: `curl -s http://metrics/proxy?query=cache_hit_ratio`
2) If hit ratio < 80% or eviction_rate > 0.1%:
   - run `scripts/cache-recover.sh --scale 1` (script will live in infra/runbooks)
   - capture `kubectl top pods -n inference` and attach to ticket
3) If errors persist after 10m -> escalate per paging rules.
I will commit scripts to infra/runbooks/cache-eviction.sh and include usage examples.

priya: Paging rule proposal: after 2 sev-3 incidents related to cache eviction within 60 minutes -> page infra oncall + infra lead. For a single severe outage (error rate > 5%) page SRE lead immediately. I'll add these thresholds into the runbook and link to rotation schedules.

alex: For the playbook, adding a fallback routing snippet for edge cases to reduce load on hot cache keys: 
```yaml
- condition: cache_eviction_rate > 0.1
  action:
    route_to: model-small
    notify: infra-oncall
```
Also proposing an automated pre-warm job on deploy to reduce cold-start eviction flurries.

simon: Good. Two additional asks:
1) Include a short 'what to capture' checklist for post-incident notes (logs, metric windows, request traces, sample payload).
2) Maya/Pria/Alex: drop PR links here when raised so I can track RB-432.

maya: Will do. PR link when ready.

priya: Draft PR created: https://git.redwood/rb/PR-789 (notes: includes paging rules and escalation matrix).

alex: Command snippets PR will be up later today. I'll include the fallback YAML and a small K8s job to pre-warm cache.

simon: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 20m runbook drill next week to validate the new steps and make sure paging behaves as expected. If anyone sees obvious missing pieces call them out now. :thumbsup:
